run_normalize_and_filter_text: run the script to normalize and language-id filter text from stdin using fasttext
run_fasttext_language_filtering: run fasttext language identification filtering on text input with a configurable probability threshold
run_text_normalization: run text normalization by removing non-alphanumeric characters and collapsing whitespace from stdin
run_lid_threshold_filtering: run language ID filtering with a custom threshold to keep only lines matching the target language
run_get_parser: run get_parser to create an argparse parser with fasttext model, language, and threshold arguments
